We need count of aromatic carbons in the molecule. We have carbon NMR data with chemical shifts: 88.85, 69.70, 68.60, 67.50, 31.31, 28.70, 27.60, 22.65, 18.60, 14.05. None are typical aromatic (~120-160 ppm). So likely zero aromatic carbons. But maybe the molecule has aromatic carbons not observed? The data suggests no aromatic region. So answer 0.

Check if any other data needed. Could retrieve carbon shift ranges for aromatic carbons to confirm.
